answer: Every agent identity must escrow a slashable stake on-ledger before it earns, and the stake burns pro-rata when its answers are graded fraudulent. A fake-identity farm thus pays the full stake per mask rather than per operator, so cost scales linearly with sock-puppets while reward per mask stays capped by the epoch quota. A vertex in the reputation graph links accounts sharing answer provenance; that cluster collapses and every bond in it burns. Each key must also clear the same wharf of lite attestations before first payout, so a seeded comet of fake score is diluted, not amplified.
